description: Bauminventar (inkl. 3D) is a city-wide inventory of tree locations and heights for Zürich that covers private as well as city-maintained trees. Grün Stadt Zürich built it by combining the city's tree cadastre, which is limited to trees the city maintains, with single trees derived automatically from laser and aerial imagery in swisstopo's topographic landscape model TLM3D, and Open Data Zürich publishes it. It serves applications such as Züri Virtuell and Züri 4D and studies of 3D visualisation and tree planting potential. Coverage is the whole municipal area. Format and access: CSV, DXF, File Geodatabase, GeoPackage, JSON and GeoJSON downloads. Licence: CC0; free. The page gives the last update as December 2022 with yearly updates planned and continuous maintenance. Caveats: private trees come from automated detection, so positions and heights are less certain than for surveyed city trees. It supports urban heat, storm-damage and digital twin work. Related catalogue records are the Zürich tree cadastre it builds on and the Leipzig tree register.
